title: Kulti
author: Mariana Zapata
summary: Sal Casillas grew up idolising Reiner Kulti, the German soccer star. When he turns up on her team's pitch after a fall from grace, she has to work with him while old feelings stir.
readIf: you enjoy slow-burn sports romance with a grumpy hero and a lot of warmth.
skipIf: you want a short book or a story where the leads get together quickly.
